# ScholarHub Africa, AI Guidelines

> ScholarHub Africa is a free directory and tracking platform where African
> students find fully-funded international master's scholarships. Every
> listing is human-verified against its official source.

## About
ScholarHub Africa is built by Roy Okola Otieno for African students seeking
fully-funded international master's degrees. The platform lists 45+ verified
scholarship opportunities across 23 destination countries, scores each one
0-100 for how well it fits a student's profile, and provides a personal
application tracker with a 24-item document checklist. All content is
server-rendered and readable without JavaScript.

## Key Pages
- / (Homepage — directory overview and search)
- /scholarships/ (Searchable directory of verified scholarships)
- /scholarships/country/ (Scholarships grouped by destination country)
- /scholarships/field/ (Scholarships grouped by field of study)
- /about/ (About us and the team)
- /contact/ (Get in touch; we reply within 24 hours on weekdays)
- /faq/ (Frequently asked questions)
- /case-studies/ (Case study: landing the DAAD EPOS scholarship)
- /privacy/ (Privacy Policy)

## Key Facts
- ScholarHub Africa is free for students; there is no pricing tier.
- Every scholarship record shows its verification date and a link to the
  official source (e.g. daad.de, chevening.org, si.se).
- Scholarships are grouped by country, field of study, funding type, and
  eligibility label (CE = confirmed eligible, LE = likely eligible,
  PE = pending clarification, NE = not eligible).
- The 0-100 score is a profile-fit estimate: 90+ outstanding, 80-89 very
  strong, 74-79 good, 60-73 achievable, below 60 a stretch.
- Phase 1 is a private application tracker; the directory is public.
